item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00256","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C04","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 supplies an exceptionally close two-part drafting template. The child's two numbered provisions reproduce C14's sequence, statutory references, operative phrasing, administrative acts, and deadlines, changing principally the covered subsection from (a), (b), and (g) to (h). C04 is an earlier version of the same machinery, while C02 shares only the more general housing-deadline extension form.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The time stipulated in subsection (c) of section 601 of the Act on or before which requests must be filed under subsection (h) of that section is executed to December 31, 1952.","parent_excerpt":"The time stipulated in subsection (c) of section 601 of the Act on or before which requests must be filed under subsections (a), (b) and (g) of that section is extended to December 31, 1952.","explanation":"Nearly verbatim first operative provision, with only the covered subsection changed; 'executed' in the child is evidently a textual error for 'extended.'"},{"child_excerpt":"The time stipulated in subsection (c) of section 601 of the Act on or before which all conditions to relinquishments or transfers pursuant to requests made under subsection (h) of that section must be complied with is extended to June 30, 1953.","parent_excerpt":"The time stipulated in subsection (c) of section 601 of the Act on or before which all conditions to relinquishments or transfers pursuant to requests made under subsections (a), (b) and (g) of that section must be complied with is extended to June 30, 1953.","explanation":"The second operative provision is likewise nearly verbatim and preserves the same legal machinery, sequence, and deadline while substituting subsection (h)."}]}
